1000.00000 – SCOPE OF REPRESENTATION
1000.02002 – Access – Subject of Bargaining

School district’s ban on the display of “flags,” broadly defined, affected exclusive representative’s ability to communicate with bargaining unit members on non-working time and in non-work areas and was thus negotiable. (p. 29.)
